sections.text: Dark God of the Lance XL

[Effects]
The following will activate if your Class is Lancer/Treasure Hunter:
Physical and magic Ability Power increases by XL - 5XL based on the dark elemental attack value.

[Activation]
When a physical or magic attack Ability is used.
Only activates when playing as Lancer/Treasure Hunter.

[Activation Rate]
M+
Activation rate against Light enemies increases to L+.
